description: This session's task list: sections of steps the agent tracks as it works, seeded from an approved plan.

settings.label: Require A Task Before Changes
settings.hint: ON (default): before a tool that changes something runs, every user request must be in the session task list (cited on a section or step, or set aside with a reason) and a step must be in progress; with no open section the app opens one itself. OFF: the agent is only reminded.
